law: every verifier change must keep this corpus green; expected values derive from CODE thresholds (fdm.py: wall 0.8 / overhang 45deg / small 0.4 / volume (300,300,350) / aspect 8 / drain 3.0; sla.py: wall 0.4 / minimum 19deg above horizontal)
semantics_note: OVERHANG conventions are explicit per process. FDM uses maximum angle from vertical: an underside trips when angle_from_up(normal) > 90 + 45deg. SLA guidance uses a minimum 19deg above horizontal: an underside trips when angle_from_up(normal) > 180 - 19deg. Thus the 46/44deg-from-vertical pair is 44/46deg above horizontal and both clear SLA. small_features trips only when >=5% of unique edges are below threshold. wall_thickness = inward ray from face centroids; severity ERROR if >10% of faces thin, else WARNING, but an Issue is emitted either way.
